title: Double descent
summary: How test error changes as a random-feature model grows.
question: In noisy synthetic regression using random Fourier features, increasing the feature count produces a test-error peak near the interpolation threshold, and ridge regularization reduces that peak.

title: Spurious correlations
summary: Testing whether a predictive shortcut improves in-distribution accuracy but harms generalization when its correlation reverses.
question: For a binary classifier trained on synthetic data, adding a feature strongly correlated with the label during training improves in-distribution accuracy but reduces accuracy when that correlation reverses at test time

title: Overfitting under label noise
summary: Testing whether increasing training-set size narrows the gap between noisy-label training accuracy and clean test accuracy.
question: For a fixed-size neural network trained on synthetic binary classification data with 20% randomly flipped training labels, increasing the training-set size reduces the gap between training accuracy and clean test accuracy
